title: Partner Health Snapshot + Action Grid for Executive Sponsors
executive_summary: One-page snapshot designed for executive sponsors: highlights current health, renewal signal, and 3 prioritized actions to de-risk renewal. Concise, scannable, and suitable for a 3–5 minute read ahead of a sponsor check-in. Intention is to replace long slide decks with a single sheet that drives decisions and clears blockers.
meeting_agenda: 2) Top 3 metrics that matter to execs (2 min)
3) Renewal signal and risk level (1 min)
4) Action grid: what we need from sponsor (2 min)
5) Asks and next check-in cadence (1 min)
one_pager_bullets: Usage: M tokens/month, trending +/– % vs prior quarter
Performance: 95th pctl latency = XX ms; errors 0.Y%
Commercial: PS consumption vs committed; upsell pipeline status
Security/Compliance: any open controls or audits impacting timeline
Top blocker: Short description and immediate impact
renewal_signal_score_explain: Renewal Signal = weighted score (0-100). Components: product stability (30%), adoption/usage (30%), exec engagement (20%), commercial alignment (10%), compliance/risk (10%). Score >75 = healthy, 50-75 = monitor (proactive playbook), <50 = high risk (escalate to AE + CRO). Use this sheet to justify ask to exec sponsor.
action_grid: High | Performance degradation in prod | Owner: Eng-Assign (Diego) | Target date: 2025-01-31 | Next step: run targeted perf-PR and share rollforward plan
Medium | Low feature adoption for 2 key routes | Owner: Solutions (Avery) | Target date: 2025-02-14 | Next step: propose two in-product prompts + 1 training session
High | Pending SOC2 evidence request | Owner: Security (Samira) | Target date: 2025-01-22 | Next step: provide documentation bundle & timeline
Low | Billing mismatch Q4 | Owner: Finance (Elena) | Target date: 2025-01-20 | Next step: reconcile invoice and issue credit if needed
qbr_email_template_subject: QBR Snapshot & Quick Ask: {CUSTOMER_NAME} — Update for {EXEC_SPONSOR_NAME}
qbr_email_template_body:
Hi {EXEC_SPONSOR_NAME},

Attached is a one-page Partner Health Snapshot ahead of our quarterly sponsor touchpoint. Key headline: [Green/Yellow/Red] — brief rationale in the first line.

Ask: We need 15 minutes to confirm the attached three actions and unblock SOC2 evidence by Jan 22. Can you slot a quick check-in next week or share the best delegate?

If helpful I can also share a 2-slide executive view (1-min talking points) for your team.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Lead — Redwood Inference
(priya@redwood.ai)
follow_up_checklist: Send snapshot to exec sponsor 3 business days before meeting
Attach short log of recent incidents (last 90 days) and mitigation steps
CC AE and Solutions engineer on scheduling email
Confirm PS utilization numbers with Finance/PS ops
Create Jira ticket for each high/medium action and tag with renewal-<customer>
note_to_self: Draft is intentionally terse. Keep executive language: outcomes and asks. Avoid engineering detail unless sponsor requests. Add a 2-line optional appendix for technical teams. Iterate with AE to calibrate commercial ask before send.
